summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for a $10.235 million offering of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due July 1, 2031, linked to the worst-performing of three indices. The notes are senior unsecured obligations under its medium-term note program, issued at $1,000 per note. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer is present. This is a routine structured note takedown under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation.
